review_candidates.title: Deskside Support Technician
review_candidates.description: About Us Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions. Purpose We are currently recruiting for a Deskside Support Technician I. Our team includes world class experts and dynamic go-getters. This is a full-time position based in Calgary, Alberta. The Executive Digital Operations Technician is responsible for delivering dedicated, hands-on technology support to Executives and their Assistants, while also supporting users and workplace technology in Houston, TX. The role provides concierge-level, responsive support for end user devices, executive offices, conference rooms, mobile technology, meetings, events, onboarding activities, and local smart hands requirements. The role supports a highly visible, time-sensitive executive environment where technology readiness, discretion, judgement, and rapid issue ownership are critical to successful day-to-day business operations. The position serves as the primary onsite technology support presence for the designated executive population and works closely with global IT teams to resolve incidents, fulfill service requests, maintain device and meeting readiness, and support day-to-day business operations. This is an individual contributor role requiring strong technical troubleshooting, ability to diagnose and resolve issues rapidly, sound judgment, professional presence, confidentiality, and a highly customer-focused approach. During periods of available capacity, the position also performs the standard local Digital Operations support responsibilities described below. Responsibilities Executive Support & Service Ownership Provide concierge-level, rapid technology support for Executives and their Assistants in accordance with the established executive service and escalation model. Maintain end-to-end ownership of executive incidents and requests, including intake, diagnosis, engagement of appropriate resolver teams, progress communication, appropriate escalation, and follow-through to confirmed resolution. Exercise sound judgement in determining when an executive impacting issue requires immediate escalation while retaining ownership and coordinating resolution through the appropriate Digital Operations leadership and technical teams. Coordinate proactively with Executive Assistants at the start of each business day to understand scheduled executive activities, important meetings, visitors, travel, workshops, and anticipated support needs. Remain available and prepared to support scheduled executive activities, balancing physical presence with the confidentiality, quiet conduct, and limited-access expectations of the environment. Prioritize support according to the designated executive service model, business impact, time sensitivity, and scheduled executive activities. Perform standard local Digital Operations duties during periods of available executive-support capacity. Provide onsite support at approved offsite executive meetings, workshops, events, or temporary meeting locations when required, including occasional local travel and work outside standard business hours. End User Support Provide in person support for desktops, laptops, monitors, peripherals, printers and mobile devices. Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, device and access related issues for local users. Support new hire onboarding, workstation setup, user moves, and day to day break/fix activities. Deliver timely user updates and ensure support activities are properly documented and managed through our approved ITSM processes. Workplace Technology & Site Support Support executive conference room and collaboration technology, including proactive readiness checks and troubleshooting of displays, audio, video, conferencing, content-sharing, and peripheral equipment. Assist with workstation setup, hot desk support, office moves, and shared workspace readiness. Maintain familiarity with executive office and meeting-space technology, including but not limited to Dell laptops, Intune-managed MacBooks, docks, displays, mobile devices, Barco ClickShare, Logitech Rally and MeetUp systems, Poly collaboration devices, and related adapters and peripherals. Support the operational readiness of color multifunction printer, including printing, copying, scanning, common troubleshooting, status and consumable checks, and coordination with the appropriate print support team when escalation is required. Maintain executive technology and associated support areas to a consistently high standard of cleanliness, organization, presentation, and operational readiness. Use approved, manufacturer-appropriate cleaning methods and leave supported equipment in an improved state following each interaction. Perform proactive checks of both Executives and Assistants workstations, conference rooms, shared technology, cabling, peripherals, and spare equipment as workload and access permit. Provide local smart hands assistance for infrastructure, network, telecom or vendor led onsite activities as required. Coordinate with regional and global support teams to ensure smooth handling of issues requiring escalation, while retaining ownership, maintaining communication, and following the issue through resolution. Device Lifecycle & Logistics Support deployment, provisioning, refresh, rebuild, recovery, and replacement of endpoint devices, including maintaining current and ready-to-deploy executive spare devices for rapid swap-out when required. Assist with asset handling activities including receipt, setup, collection, return, and local coordination of hardware movements. Support termination hardware retrieval, end of lease handling, and eWaste / recycling processes in alignment with company standards. Maintain accurate awareness of local inventory, device readiness, and support requirements for the site, including a small, restricted stock of executive laptops, mobile devices, adapters, peripherals, and AV equipment. Operational Support & Continuous Improvement Perform first-line diagnosis, troubleshooting, and resolution of onsite IT issues, escalating where needed while maintaining end-to-end ownership of executive-impacting incidents and requests. Identify recurring issues and improvement opportunities affecting end user experience, support responsiveness or local site readiness. Partner with Service Desk, Infrastructure Teams, and third-party providers to help maintain stable service delivery. Contribute to consistent support practices, documentation, and service quality across the local environment. Health, Safety & Compliance Demonstrate commitment to health, safety and compliance requirements applicable to the office or site environment. Follow company processes for security, asset management, access, and technology handling. Complete all required site or office inductions and work in accordance with local HSE expectations. Physical Demand/Work Environment The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to speak or listen. The employee frequently is required to walk and sit. The employee is occasionally required to stand. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Visual Acuity: must be adequate to perform all required Job Description tasks in a safe manner. The noise level in the work environment is usually quiet. Work is usually done in an office setting and sometimes at a client facility or job site. This job description is intended to describe the nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this position. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities and duties required of the job incumbents. What You Will Bring Technical and Industry Experience: Experience in deskside, desktop, field, executive, or end user support within a professional business environment. Strong hands-on troubleshooting skills across Dell Windows endpoints, Apple MacBook endpoints, standard business applications, docks, monitors, peripherals, mobile devices, printing, and user access issues. Experience providing in person support to end users, including onboarding, break/fix, and workplace technology support. Familiarity with IT Service Management tools such as ServiceNow. Ability to work independently with limited supervision, manage multiple priorities, exercise sound judgment, and remain composed in time-sensitive or high-visibility situations. Exceptional communication, discretion, follow-through, and customer service skills, with the ability to build trust with senior executives and their assistants. Demonstrated ability to handle confidential or sensitive information and operate with discretion in an executive environment. Consistently professional appearance, conduct, and communication appropriate for an executive environment with senior leaders, customers, and external visitors. Ability to anticipate needs, conduct proactive readiness checks, and maintain organized, current spare equipment and restricted executive inventory. Ability to travel locally and provide occasional support outside standard business hours for approved executive meetings, workshops, or events. Experience supporting conference room, meeting room, or collaboration technologies such as Barco ClickShare, Logitech Rally and MeetUp, and Poly collaboration devices. Experience supporting mobile devices, including iPhone, iPad, and Android, and familiarity supporting Intune-managed MacBooks and macOS. Familiarity with hardware lifecycle processes including provisioning, refresh, returns, and disposal coordination. Experience providing smart hands support for network, service, or infrastructure related onsite activities. Experience working in engineering, industrial, operational, or multi-site business environments. Previous experience providing dedicated technology support to senior executives or other high-profile users in a global organization. Required Education – Qualifications, Accreditation, Training: Bachelor’s Degree required. Moving forward together We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard. And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here. And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

review_candidates.title: Desk Side Support Field Engineer
review_candidates.description: Overview NSC Global is looking for Level 1 Field Service Technicians to deliver on site technical support for customer systems. The role covers on site hardware troubleshooting, repair and replacement, diagnostics, service call updates, parts handling and customer communication, in line with agreed service levels and established field service procedures. Technicians attend customer locations, validate reported faults, complete the intervention and provide accurate updates throughout. The position requires sound technical troubleshooting ability, professional communication, close adherence to process and the ability to work to deadlines driven by service level agreements. Responsibilities Attend customer sites within agreed service windows and complete each intervention to the required standard. Perform on site troubleshooting, diagnostics, hardware repair and component replacement across desktops, laptops and related client hardware. Validate warranty status, asset identification and diagnostic findings before completing any repair. Apply approved diagnostic tools and methods, including built in diagnostics, LED fault codes and structured logical troubleshooting. Confirm receipt of service calls, manage estimated arrival updates and maintain accurate records in the required systems, with arrival updates within 15 minutes and closure within 30 minutes of service completion. Generate electronic service reports through the designated field service platform and obtain customer sign off following each intervention. Reinstall BIOS, drivers and operating systems where instructed and where approved recovery media is available. Troubleshoot hardware related networking faults falling within the scope of the service call. Order additional parts through the approved process, following completion of documented troubleshooting. Collect, manage, package, label and return defective or unused parts within the required process and timescales. Keep customers informed throughout the intervention, including next steps, repeat visits and parts requirements. Escalate unusual incidents immediately, including customer dissatisfaction, damage, missing equipment, unsafe environments or any issue affecting service delivery. Comply with all electrostatic discharge, safety and documented procedural requirements, and display the required identification while on customer sites. Report process deviations and quality issues, and contribute to continuous improvement. Qualifications Experience in Level 1 technical support, field service, desktop support, break/fix support or a comparable customer facing IT support role. Sound understanding of PC, laptop and client hardware components. Working knowledge of operating systems, BIOS, drivers, hardware fault isolation and basic networking principles. Ability to follow structured diagnostic processes and document troubleshooting steps accurately. Confident communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues clearly to non technical customers. Ability to work independently at customer sites while observing agreed process, safety and escalation procedures. Strong time management across appointments, travel and service level expectations. High attention to detail in ticket updates, notes, parts handling and service reporting. Fluent written and spoken knowledge of the local language of the assigned territory, sufficient for direct customer contact on site. Proficient written and spoken English, sufficient for technical documentation, service reporting and communication with the wider support organisation. A valid driving licence and access to a personal vehicle for travel to customer locations. CompTIA A+ certification is desirable, particularly for technicians new to this area of client hardware support. Tools and equipment Smartphone or tablet compatible with the required field service applications. Reliable internet connectivity suitable for field service updates and application use. Access to an electrostatic discharge kit and standard computer repair tools. Bootable USB key and the tools required for system disassembly and component replacement. Own vehicle available for daily travel between customer sites, with secure storage for tools and parts. Compliance and security Successful completion of all required criminal background checks prior to attending any customer site. Authorisation to work in the assigned territory in accordance with applicable law. Completion of all required authorisations and product, security, privacy and process training before performing service calls, and maintenance of that authorisation thereafter. Training is provided. Compliance with customer site access, security, privacy, safety and conduct requirements, and with all policies relating to confidential information, customer data and incident escalation. Technicians must be free of drugs and alcohol when performing service activity.

review_candidates.title: National External Software Developer (SafePass360)
review_candidates.description: Job Description External Software Developer (SafePass360) Background & Context Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (SEA) is a zero-tolerance area for the United Nations Population Fund. In South Sudan, where SEA risks remain high, frontline humanitarian workers often lack access to continuous PSEA learning due to low internet connectivity and ad-hoc training availability. UNFPA South Sudan, as a finalist in the 2026 PSEA Ideation Challenge, is developing SafePass360 —an offline-first, zero-data digital safeguarding companion. Designed for aid workers in low-connectivity, high-risk deep-field zones (piloting in Renk and Yambio), SafePass360 provides AI-based, interactive PSEA guidance. The platform hosts localized, quantized Small Language Models (SLMs) and audio-visual scenarios directly on shared devices (Android, iOS, Windows, Linux) without requiring internet access or transmitting Personally Identifiable Information (PII). Objective of the Consultancy The consultant will engineer, test, and optimize the core application codebase for SafePass360. This includes integrating quantized SLM runtimes into a Flutter framework, implementing zero-PII local data management with AES-256 encryption, building multi-lingual audio/narrative decision engines, and establishing an opportunistic synchronization layer for anonymous analytics. Scope of Work & Technical Requirements Under the technical supervision of the UNFPA ICT & Innovation Analyst, the consultant will deliver: Core Architecture & Local AI Integration (Flutter ONNX GGUF) Develop a clean, cross-platform Flutter application shell targeting Android, Windows, and Linux. Integrate and benchmark runtime bindings (e.g., ONNX Runtime Mobile or llama.cpp) to run 4-bit quantized SLMs (e.g., Phi-3-mini or Qwen-1.5B) alongside lightweight offline Voice-to-Text (STT) and Text-to-Speech (TTS) engines entirely on-device without active network traffic. Optimize memory consumption to ensure stable inference on legacy hardware (down to 4GB RAM) without crashes. Scenario Engine, Media Integration & Localization Implement a JSON-driven state machine to execute 15 localized interactive PSEA scenarios (provided by UNFPA). Integrate dynamic multi-lingual UI and audio playback toggles for English and Juba Arabic voice tracks. Render lightweight avatar animations (Lottie/Rive framework) to keep the app binary under 150MB. Security Architecture & Zero-PII Data Engine Implement local NoSQL storage (Hive/ObjectBox) protected by AES-256 encryption. Hardcode strict Zero-PII memory management ensuring AI chat context is strictly volatile in RAM and completely wiped upon session closure. Build offline logic for generating cryptographically signed QR codes for the Safeguard Credit System. Opportunistic Synchronization & CMS Integration Program a background connectivity listener to detect authorized local Wi-Fi networks. Build a synchronization pipeline that securely batches encrypted, anonymous usage telemetry to the central Juba CMS dashboard when online. Key Deliverables & Payment Schedule Payments Are Milestone-based Milestone 1 (Due November 07, 2026 - 30% / $1,200): Functional cross-platform Flutter app repository; Quantized local SLM + offline STT/TTS engine running on low-spec hardware; Zero-PII sandboxed local execution workspace verified. Milestone 2 (Due November 20, 2026 - 40% / $1,600): 15 interactive decision tree scenarios integrated; English & Juba Arabic text/audio asset bundle synced; Renk & Yambio hardcoded directories operational; AES-256 encrypted registry & scannable QR badge engine live. Milestone 3 (Due November 31, 2026 - 30% / $1,200): Opportunistic background sync pipeline verified against Juba CMS; Beta builds cleared following field deployment; Final clean codebase & documentation uploaded to shared global repository. Required Qualifications & Experience Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline. Core Technical Competencies: Minimum 4 years of proven software engineering experience with strong proficiency in Flutter / Dart. Demonstrated experience in Edge-AI compilation and integrating localized machine learning runtimes (ONNX Runtime, llama.cpp, TensorFlow Lite, or PyTorch Mobile) on mobile/desktop platforms. Strong expertise in local mobile databases (Hive, ObjectBox, or SQLite) with built-in AES-256 encryption. Proficient with audio/media streaming controllers and state management patterns (BLoC, Provider, or Riverpod) in Flutter. Language & Soft Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Experience of gender and sexual exploitation and abuse is an added advantage. Experience working on humanitarian, open-source, or field-oriented software projects in low-resource environments is an added advantage. How to Apply Interested candidates' cover letters must include detailed relevant technical experience (especially Edge-AI and Flutter), and links to relevant code repositories (e.g., GitHub) by October 9, 2026.
